title: Harness of Minervini v2 ticker.risk response

examples: scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline ticker risk AAPL --market-state favorable --eligibility-state eligible --setup-state ready --fundamentals-state supports_convergence --entry-price 200 --stop-price 188 --upside-price 224 --average-gain-pct 24
scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline ticker risk AAPL --mode active --entry-price 200 --entry-date 2026-08-10 --stop-price 188

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

average_gain_pct.description: The trader's realized average gain percentage. Prospective mode cannot reach BUY-READY without it; its absence is reported as missing evidence, not a relaxed cap. In active mode it is one of the two reference points for selling into strength, reported as a distance from the position's return and never as a trigger.

completed_stop_breach.description: Assert a stop breach on completed evidence.

current_price.description: Optional explicit latest completed price. A value at or below the stop can trigger SELL, but a value above it cannot establish HOLD without the provider-audited completed price path.

entry_date.description: Actual ISO entry date; required in active mode.

entry_price.description: Positive planned or actual entry price.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

initial_stop_price.description: The hard stop the trade started with, for when --stop-price has since been raised. Initial risk is entry minus this, and R multiples and 3R protection are measured from it; without it a raised stop leaves R unmeasured rather than measured from the wrong risk. Declaring it beside a different --stop-price requires --stop-effective-date, because a raised stop was raised on some date.

invalidation_condition.description: Observable structural invalidation condition. Pair it with --invalidation-price in active mode: a condition the harness cannot evaluate against completed bars is reported as missing evidence rather than assumed unbreached.

invalidation_price.description: Positive structural invalidation price. In active mode it is audited over completed bars from --entry-date, alongside and independently of the hard stop.

live_stop_breach.description: Assert a live breach; SELL requires live_stop_check too.

management_profile.description: Opt into a tagged TraderLion practice-layer management default. tl_stage12 is the Stage 1 and 2 rule: once the position has shown a 5 percent profit, REDUCE half and RAISE_STOP to breakeven. A profile adds management_actions under HOLD, each marked binds false and source [TL], and never touches the verdict.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

stop_effective_date.description: Calendar date when --stop-price became effective in active mode; defaults to --entry-date. The audit begins with the first completed bar on or after this date.

stop_price.description: Positive hard-stop price. In active mode, every completed daily Low is audited from the stop's effective date through --as-of.

upside_price.description: Positive evidence-based reward reference; required in prospective mode.

limitations: This capability never recommends portfolio allocation or position size. A REDUCE action names a fraction of the position, which is a selling discipline, not an allocation.
A hard stop may not exceed 10% or half the realized average gain; --average-gain-pct is required for a prospective verdict and reward-to-risk must be at least 2:1.

A completed current price above the protective level cannot establish HOLD: the provider must cover every completed daily Low from --stop-effective-date through --as-of; a recovered price does not erase an earlier breach.

Each protective level is audited from its own effective date: the hard stop from --stop-effective-date, the structural invalidation from --entry-date. A breach of either is a SELL, and HOLD requires every declared level to be cleared over its whole window.
--stop-effective-date defaults to --entry-date. When a stop was raised or replaced later, supply its actual effective date so the newer stop is not applied retroactively.

Active-mode chronology is checked before any evidence is fetched: --entry-date cannot follow --as-of, and --stop-effective-date can neither precede --entry-date nor follow --as-of. An asserted breach outranks evidence nobody gathered, but never a request that contradicts itself or declares no exit plan.
An explicit --current-price at or below the stop can trigger SELL; a partial-session breach must instead use the explicit live-stop flags.
A live stop breach triggers SELL only when --live-stop-check is explicit; ordinary gates use completed bars.

A completed breach records the breaching session's Open and whether it opened below the level (gap_through_stop): a stop the market gapped through was never available at its price, and the record does not pretend it was.
The reducer does not infer unsupported market, eligibility, setup, or fundamentals states.
x-capability-contract.output: The sole final ticker verdict with component states, completed stop-path evidence, failed/waiting/missing evidence, stop constraints, reward-to-risk, and 3R protection context. An active HOLD also carries management_actions -- what to do while holding, each naming its action (RAISE_STOP, REDUCE, or REVIEW), the claim it comes from, and the measurement behind it; the list is empty when nothing is due, and SELL and INCOMPLETE carry no actions because there is nothing left to manage or no established position to manage. Three R is measured from the highest completed High since the entry session (max_high_since_entry, with its date), not from the last close: a gain that was reached and given back is exactly what the rule protects, and the last close is only the floor of what was reached when no High is available. Every limit comes from the doctrine registry: a gate decides pass or fail, while a band such as the ordinary loss target reports the measurement, the source's range, where the measurement sat against that range, and which edge of it is the good one -- a stop tighter than the range is outside it on the favourable side.
prerequisites: Prospective mode should consume market.snapshot, ticker.qualify, ticker.setup, and ticker.fundamentals verdicts.

status_meanings.needs_input: Required evidence is missing, so the domain verdict is INCOMPLETE.
status_meanings.ok: A complete BUY-READY, WAIT, AVOID, HOLD, or SELL verdict was produced; active HOLD includes a clear completed stop path.
status_meanings.partial: The completed-price provider failed, could not cover the full active stop window, or stopped before the requested session.
status_meanings.unavailable: An internal required capability cannot be evaluated.

x-capability-contract.summary: Reduce converged prospective evidence to BUY-READY, WAIT, AVOID, or INCOMPLETE, or active-position evidence to HOLD, SELL, or INCOMPLETE.
